formbricks.help_text: Collect registration information and optional add-on selections via Formbricks survey.
formbricks.setup_dialog_content:
The Formbricks survey serves two purposes:

1. Collect Registration Information
Collect applicant information, motivation letters, and other registration details that will be displayed in the applications overview.

2. Define Add-on Prices (for payment-enabled courses)
If your course requires payment, you can include questions about optional add-ons (e.g., "Would you like to add a certificate? (+€50)"). The system automatically extracts prices mentioned in survey questions.

Tip: If you offer different price categories via add-ons (e.g., Basic, Standard, Premium), set the base price to 0. The InfoPanel will then display "Price: variable". For more details, see the base price help text.

---

Hidden Fields Configuration

Important: You must configure Hidden Fields in your Formbricks survey!

Required Hidden Fields:
• eduhubUserId - Automatically filled with EduHub user ID
• eduhubCourseId - Automatically filled with course ID
• eduhubEnrollmentId - Automatically filled with enrollment ID (optional)

In Formbricks: Edit Survey → Enable Hidden Fields → Add these field IDs. Without this configuration, responses cannot be properly matched.

Note: eduhubEnrollmentId is optional because the enrollment is created AFTER the survey is completed during registration.

---

Add-on Price Extraction

For courses with payment enabled:
1. Include add-on selection answer options with price information in your survey questions (e.g., "Certificate (+€50)" or "Workshop materials: €25")
2. Use the "Validate Add-ons" button in the Pricing Settings section
3. The system will analyze your survey and extract detected prices
4. Review and validate the extracted prices in the validation dialog
5. Validated add-ons are automatically synced with Stripe for payment processing

In Formbricks: Edit Survey → Enable Hidden Fields → Add these field IDs. Without this configuration, responses cannot be properly matched.

pricing.title: Pricing Settings
pricing.base_price_help: The base price for the course in the smallest currency unit (e.g., cents for EUR). Special rules apply when set to 0.
pricing.base_price_dialog_content:
The base price is the base amount for course participation and is specified in the smallest currency unit (e.g., cents for EUR).

--- Standard Case: Base Price > 0 ---

When you set a base price above 0, this amount is displayed in the course InfoPanel. If you have additionally defined add-ons, a note "+ Add-ons" will appear.

Example:
• Base price: 5000 cents (50.00 EUR)
• Add-on: Certificate for 1500 cents (15.00 EUR)
→ InfoPanel shows: "50.00 EUR + Add-ons"

--- Special Case: Base Price = 0 ---

A base price of 0 has special significance and provides flexibility for different price categories:

1. With Add-ons:
   The InfoPanel displays "Price: variable". This is particularly useful when:
   • Offering different price categories via the questionnaire
   • Participants can choose between different packages
   • The final price depends on individual add-on selections

   Example: You offer different participation packages:
   • Basic participation: 0 EUR (base price)
   • Standard package: +50 EUR (add-on)
   • Premium package: +100 EUR (add-on)
   → InfoPanel shows: "Price: variable"

2. Without Add-ons:
   The InfoPanel displays "Free".
   The course is completely free without payment options.

--- Integration with Questionnaire ---

Add-ons are defined and validated via the Formbricks questionnaire:
1. Include selection options with price information in your questionnaire
2. Use the "Validate Add-ons" button to extract prices
3. Validated add-ons are synced with Stripe
4. During registration, participants select their desired options

For more details on questionnaire integration, see the help text for the Questionnaire URL.
